notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Repeat each turn.
